g1.label: 1. Classes start at what time?
g1.why: The text says classes start at 7:45 at Lena's American school.

g2.label: 2. How does Lena get to school in Germany?
g2.why: The text says Lena usually gets to school in Germany on foot or by bike.

g3.label: 3. Which activity did Lena join?
g3.why: The text says Lena joined the school newspaper in America.

g4.label: 4. What grading system is used?
g4.why: The text says American schools use letters A–F for grading.

g5.label: 5. Which month is Thanksgiving?
g5.why: The text says Thanksgiving is celebrated in November.

g6.correct: her American family and new experiences
accept: her American family and new experiences
g6.label: 6. What was Lena thankful for?
g6.why: The text says Lena was thankful for her American family and new experiences.

g1.label: 1. Lena enjoyed ___ foods
g1.why: ‘Enjoy’ is always followed by the gerund (-ing) form, not the infinitive.

g2.label: 2. She decided ___ the newspaper
g2.why: ‘Decide’ is always followed by the to-infinitive.

g3.label: 3. Students avoid ___ to school
g3.why: ‘Avoid’ is always followed by the gerund (-ing) form.

g4.label: 4. Lena hoped ___ her English
g4.why: ‘Hope’ is always followed by the to-infinitive.

g5.label: 5. She didn't mind ___ up early
g5.why: ‘Mind’ is always followed by the gerund (-ing) form.

g6.label: 6. Lena refused ___ pumpkin pie
g6.why: ‘Refuse’ is always followed by the to-infinitive.

g7.label: 7. Emma suggested ___ the drama club
g7.why: ‘Suggest’ is always followed by the gerund (-ing) form.

g8.label: 8. Lena managed ___ friends
g8.why: ‘Manage’ is always followed by the to-infinitive.

g1.label: 1. The teacher asked the students ___
g1.why: ‘Ask someone to do something’ uses the pattern verb + object + to-infinitive.

g2.label: 2. Parents expected her ___
g2.why: ‘Expect someone to do something’ uses the pattern verb + object + to-infinitive.

g3.label: 3. Her host mother told her ___
g3.why: ‘Tell someone to do something’ uses the pattern verb + object + to-infinitive.

g4.label: 4. The coach wanted the team ___
g4.why: ‘Want someone to do something’ uses the pattern verb + object + to-infinitive.

g5.label: 5. Her teacher encouraged her ___
g5.why: ‘Encourage someone to do something’ uses the pattern verb + object + to-infinitive.

g6.label: 6. The school didn't allow students ___
g6.why: ‘Allow someone to do something’ uses the pattern verb + object + to-infinitive.

g7.label: 7. Emma persuaded Lena ___
g7.why: ‘Persuade someone to do something’ uses the pattern verb + object + to-infinitive.

g8.label: 8. Parents reminded her ___
g8.why: ‘Remind someone to do something’ uses the pattern verb + object + to-infinitive.
